scope.summary: Implement soft-tissue collision vs hands, props, and cloth in the unified collision world (spec 13.20; REQ-028 squish clause, VaM quality bar): region cages collide with body-part colliders, imported prop colliders, and cloth so breasts/glutes/belly squish on contact and recover, with documented coupling modes.
acceptance_criteria: Region cages collide with hand/body colliders, imported prop mesh colliders (MT-464 lane), and cloth within the one unified collision world; contact deforms the cage while volume constraints redistribute (squish, not shrink).
Grip test: a sphere/capsule pressed into a breast cage produces local indentation plus surrounding bulge, and release restores the rest shape within tolerance.
Cloth coupling mode documented: cloth sees the deformed soft-tissue surface, with one-way vs two-way coupling selectable and the default recorded.
No tunneling at production step rates for documented penetration speeds; the CCD budget for soft-tissue contacts is documented.
scope.risk_if_missed: Squish-on-contact is the VaM-set quality bar for interactive adult content; without unified-world collision, hands and props pass through breasts and glutes and every insertion or grope shot reads as rigid CGI intersection.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
